_note: Visual styles Sufi saved on 2026-11-10 for @aiwithsufi explainer Reels and carousel posts. NOT for the daily AI News carousel (keep its current look). Propose one style in every explainer plan (rotate; don't repeat the previous explainer's style unless he asks) and build it after approval. Keep everything original: no real creators' branding, no LEGO logo or minifigures, no known characters.

build_notes: 2d styles: add as a skin/theme in aiwithsufi/tools/reel_engine.py and explainer_carousel.py (Pillow). 3d styles: need a 3D renderer (e.g. three.js rendered frame-by-frame with the pre-installed Playwright Chromium, or Blender); tell Sufi in the plan that 3D takes longer. Carousels are still images: apply the style's look to static slides.
